content.text:
The patch still permits stale compatibility metadata or widget cache updates to override or contaminate authoritative card restoration under reproducible event orderings. These lifecycle failures can render the wrong card or carry state across distinct results.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Correlate same-target metadata after standard results — /Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/mcp-app-v8/packages/owletto/src/mcp-apps/_shared/host.tsx:964-969
  If a compatibility output has already set `latestOutputTarget`, a newer standard `toolresult` does not clear it. A delayed metadata-only event from that same target therefore makes `metadataOnlyRequiresCorrelation` false; its stale snapshot capability is accepted and can replace the current standard card and view state. Treat metadata after authoritative standard data as unpaired, or reset `latestOutputTarget` at that boundary.

- [P1] Keep widget cache from cancelling ID-only restores — /Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/mcp-app-v8/packages/owletto/src/mcp-apps/_shared/host.tsx:610-614
  During an ID-only historical restore (`toolInfo` present, no capability), a widgetState-only `openai:set_globals` update can change `dataRevision` even though it is only a display cache. If its payload differs, this guard rejects the authoritative `restore_lobu_app_result` response and no retry is scheduled, leaving the stale cache rendered. Track authoritative revisions separately or prevent widget-only updates from invalidating an active ID restore.

- [P2] Do not treat matching payloads as result identity — /Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/mcp-app-v8/packages/owletto/src/mcp-apps/_shared/host.tsx:601-603
  When stale metadata comes from the other same-origin target, the correlation check relies on equality of display-safe JSON. Separate calls can legitimately produce byte-identical results, so an old capability passes this check and its `tool_name`, disclosure/pagination state, and approval metadata are attached to the current card. Per-result state needs an actual identity association; payload equality should not authorize cross-target binding.
